headline: 暑期档终局：电影剧集热度双燃
headlineEn: Final Summer Stretch: Movies and TV Heat Up
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周7部新片蓄力；电影《最后的曙光》领跑热度，剧集《侠探杰克》持续霸榜，《绿灯军团》双榜齐进。
summaryEn: No new movies hit theaters today, with 7 new titles this week; film 'Final Dawn' leads daily heat, while TV series 'Reacher' keeps topping charts and 'Green Lantern Corps' appears on both movie and TV rankings.

industryHighlights.text: 今日无新片上映，本周累计新片7部，市场靠存量影片支撑。
industryHighlights.en: No new movies released today; 7 new titles this week, with existing films carrying the market.

industryHighlights.text: 电影《最后的曙光》领跑单日热度，成今日最受关注影片。
industryHighlights.en: Movie 'Final Dawn' tops daily heat as the most-watched title.

industryHighlights.text: 剧集《绿灯军团》同时出现在本周电影与剧集热榜，科幻IP多点开花。
industryHighlights.en: 'Green Lantern Corps' charts on both weekly movie and TV lists, showing strong sci-fi IP momentum.

industryHighlights.text: 近期无重要定档动态，后续市场静待新作。
industryHighlights.en: No notable upcoming release announcements; the market awaits fresh titles.
